title: Automatic sprinkler system.
officialText: Buildings and structures shall be equipped throughout with an automatic sprinkler system in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1 of the New York City Building Code, except where an alternative fire-extinguishing system is approved in accordance with Section 904.1 of the New York City Building Code.
